00049 BinaryOpUGenInternal::BinaryOpUGenInternal(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand, int channel) throw()
00050 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs)
00051 {   
00052     if(channel < 0)
00053     {
00054         inputs[LeftOperand] = leftOperand;
00055         inputs[RightOperand] = rightOperand;
00056     }
00057     else
00058     {
00059         int numLeftChannels = leftOperand.getNumChannels();
00060         int numRightChannels = rightOperand.getNumChannels();
00061         UGenInternal* leftInternal = leftOperand.getInternalUGen(channel % numLeftChannels);
00062         UGenInternal* rightInternal = rightOperand.getInternalUGen(channel % numRightChannels);
00063         
00064         inputs[LeftOperand] = UGen(leftInternal->getChannelInternal(channel), channel);
00065         inputs[RightOperand] = UGen(rightInternal->getChannelInternal(channel), channel);
00066     }
00067 }

00146 BinaryDivideUGen::BinaryDivideUGen(UGen const& leftOperand, UGen const& rightOperand) throw() 
00147 {   
00148     const int numRightChannels = rightOperand.getNumChannels();
00149     const int numLeftChannels = leftOperand.getNumChannels();
00150     
00151     if(numLeftChannels > numRightChannels) 
00152         initInternal(numLeftChannels); 
00153     else 
00154         initInternal(numRightChannels); 
00155     
00156     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++) 
00157     { 
00158         const int rightIndex = i % numRightChannels;
00159         if(rightOperand.isConst(rightIndex))
00160         {
00161             // special case where the right operand is a scalar
00162             // use multiplication by the reciprocal instead
00163             float reciprocalRightOperand = 1.f / rightOperand.getValue(rightIndex);
00164             internalUGens[i] = new BinaryMultiplyUGenInternal(leftOperand, reciprocalRightOperand); 
00165         }
00166         else
00167             internalUGens[i] = new BinaryDivideUGenInternal(leftOperand, rightOperand); 
00168     }
00169 }

00172 void BinaryDivideUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00173 { 
00174     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00175     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00176     float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00177     float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00178     
00179     while(numSamplesToProcess--) 
00180     { 
00181         // maybe should "zap" the output?
00182         *outputSamples++ = *leftOperandSamples++ / *rightOperandSamples++; 
00183     }
00184 }

00187 void BinaryDivideUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00188 { 
00189     const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize(); 
00190     unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize; 
00191     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00192     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00193     float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00194     float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel); 
00195     int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize; 
00196     
00197     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) 
00198     { 
00199         if(numKrSamples == 0) 
00200             value = *leftOperandSamples / *rightOperandSamples; // maybe should "zap" the output?
00201         
00202         numKrSamples        =  krBlockSize - numKrSamples; 
00203         blockPosition       += numKrSamples; 
00204         leftOperandSamples  += numKrSamples; 
00205         rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples; 
00206     
00207         while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) 
00208         { 
00209             *outputSamples++ = value; 
00210             --numSamplesToProcess; 
00211             --numKrSamples; 
00212         } 
00213     }
00214 }

00238 UGenArray UGenArray::operator / (UGenArray const& rightOperand) const throw() 
00239 { 
00240     int size; 
00241     if(internal->size_ > rightOperand.internal->size_) 
00242         size = internal->size_; 
00243     else 
00244         size = rightOperand.internal->size_; 
00245 
00246     UGenArray newArray(size); 
00247 
00248     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++) 
00249     { 
00250         newArray.internal->array[i] = wrapAt(i) / rightOperand.wrapAt(i); 
00251     } 
00252 
00253     return newArray; 
00254 }

00256 Buffer Buffer::operator / (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw() 
00257 { 
00258     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; 
00259     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_; 
00260     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_; 
00261     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize; 
00262     
00263     Buffer newBuffer(maxSize, newNumChannels, false); 
00264     
00265     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++) 
00266     { 
00267         int numSamples; 
00268         float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data; 
00269         float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data; 
00270         float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data; 
00271         
00272         if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) 
00273         { 
00274             numSamples = maxSize; 
00275             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00276             { 
00277                 *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples / *rightSamples++; 
00278             } 
00279         } 
00280         else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) 
00281         { 
00282             float reciprocalRightOperand = 1.f / *rightSamples;
00283             numSamples = maxSize; 
00284             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00285             { 
00286                 *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ * reciprocalRightOperand; 
00287             } 
00288         } 
00289         else 
00290         { 
00291             numSamples = minSize; 
00292             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00293             { 
00294                 *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ / *rightSamples++; 
00295             } 
00296             
00297             numSamples = diffSize; 
00298             while(--numSamples >= 0) 
00299             { 
00300                 *outputSamples++ = 0.f; 
00301             } 
00302         } 
00303     } 
00304 
00305     return newBuffer; 
00306 }

00324 Value Value::operator / (Value const& rightOperand) const throw()
00325 {
00326     Value TempValue = *this; // copy away const
00327     if(containsInternalType<ValueInternal>() && (TempValue.getValue() == 1.0))
00328     {
00329         if(rightOperand.containsInternalType<UnaryReciprocalValueInternal>())
00330             return (dynamic_cast<UnaryReciprocalValueInternal*>(rightOperand.internal))->getOperand();
00331         else
00332             return rightOperand.reciprocal();
00333     }
00334     else    
00335         return BinaryDivideValue(*this, rightOperand); // default
00336 }

00338 ValueArray operator / (const double leftOperand, ValueArray const& rightOperand) throw()
00339 {
00340     return ValueArray(leftOperand) / rightOperand;

00342 
00343 ValueArray ValueArray::operator / (ValueArray const& rightOperand) const throw()
00344 {
00345     if(size() == 0)                                                                                                 
00346         return rightOperand;                                                                                        
00347     else if(rightOperand.size() == 0)                                                                               
00348         return *this;                                                                                               
00349     else {                                                                                                      
00350         const int maxSize = ugen::max(size(), rightOperand.size());                                                 
00351         ValueArray newArray(maxSize);                                                                               
00352         for(int i = 0; i < maxSize; i++) {                                                                          
00353             newArray.put(i, wrapAt(i) / rightOperand.wrapAt(i));                                                
00354         }                                                                                                           
00355         return newArray;                                                                                            
00356     }   
00357 }
